jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international organization operating within the pharmaceutical and health-related sector. Supporting customers across Western Europe, they are known for their commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. To strengthen their Customer Service team, they are looking for a temporary colleague who can help maintain their high service standards.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage customer orders from entry to delivery.
• Communicate with customers, warehouses, and sales teams.
• Handle returns, claims, and transport-related issues.
• Resolve customer inquiries and identify effective solutions.
• Maintain accurate documentation and ERP administration.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• 1-3 years of experience in customer service or administration.
• Familiarity with ERP systems, ideally Microsoft Dynamics or Axapta.
• Fluent in English; Spanish, Italian of German are a strong plus.
• Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to perform under pressure.

Looking for an opportunity where you can make a visible impact and help shape a growing operation from the ground up? Our client is a young and expanding logistics organization based in Wommelgem, specializing in the storage, packaging, and distribution of healthcare and pharmaceutical products.

As part of an international group this company manages the flow of products from global manufacturers to customers across Central- and South- America, Europe and Asia. The Belgian operation was launched recently and currently employs a small team of around eight people, creating a unique opportunity to join a business in an exciting growth phase.

As Warehouse Supervisor, you will take ownership of the day-to-day warehouse operations and lead the Belgian warehouse team. You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while helping build processes and structure within a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate the warehouse team, ensuring smooth daily operations.
• Manage inbound, outbound, picking, packing, inventory, and stock accuracy activities.
• Monitor warehouse KPIs and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
• Act as the local key user for the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Coordinate staffing, holidays, absences, and workforce planning in collaboration with local management.
• Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and operational procedures.
• Work closely with the international operations team in headquarters and support the continued growth of the Belgian site.

You enjoy being present on the warehouse floor, taking ownership, and motivating people to achieve operational goals.

Who You Are?

• A natural team leader who leads by example and communicates clearly.
• Structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented.
• Comfortable working in a dynamic international logistics environment.
• Focused on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
• Proactive and capable of making operational decisions independently.
must haves

• Minimum 3 years of experience within warehouse or logistics operations.
• Proven experience as a Warehouse Supervisor, Team Leader, or Warehouse Coordinator.
• Experience managing and motivating operational teams.
• Strong understanding of inbound, outbound, inventory management, and warehouse KPIs.
• Hands-on experience with a Warehouse Management System (WMS).
• Good knowledge of international logistics and imported goods flows.
• Professional proficiency in English and Spanish. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels, a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, is located at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium). We specialize in the inspection, maintenance, and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. Over the past years, we have successfully expanded our team of Jet Engine Mechanics. As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a limited number of additional mechanics who combine strong technical skills, precision and a genuine passion for aircraft engines. We are looking for people who aspire to become true LEAP engine specialists and who want to contribute to one of the world's leading LEAP engine MRO facilities.The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your RoleAs a Jet Engine Mechanic, you will ensure the airworthiness and performance of LEAP engines through maintenance, disassembly & assembly. Your responsibilities include:

• Managing engine induction into the workshop and reporting defects or damage
• Dismantling and assembling engine modules
• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements
• Participating in continuous improvement projects
• Completing technical documentation for traceability
• Reporting anomalies in work instructions and proposing improvements

Your ProfileWe are looking for mechanics who take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in aircraft engines
• A high level of precision, ownership and attention to detail
• A strong quality and safety mindset
• Curiosity, motivation and a willingness to continuously learn
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.description:
Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?
For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage.

Looking for an opportunity where you can make a visible impact and help shape a growing operation from the ground up? Our client is a young and expanding logistics organization based in Wommelgem, specializing in the storage, packaging, and distribution of healthcare and pharmaceutical products.

As part of an international group this company manages the flow of products from global manufacturers to customers across Central- and South- America, Europe and Asia. The Belgian operation was launched recently and currently employs a small team of around eight people, creating a unique opportunity to join a business in an exciting growth phase.

As Warehouse Supervisor, you will take ownership of the day-to-day warehouse operations and lead the Belgian warehouse team. You will play a key role in ensuring operational excellence while helping build processes and structure within a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate the warehouse team, ensuring smooth daily operations.

• Manage inbound, outbound, picking, packing, inventory, and stock accuracy activities.

• Monitor warehouse KPIs and identify opportunities for operational improvement.

• Act as the local key user for the Warehouse Management System (WMS).

• Coordinate staffing, holidays, absences, and workforce planning in collaboration with local management.

• Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and operational procedures.

• Work closely with the international operations team in headquarters and support the continued growth of the Belgian site.

You enjoy being present on the warehouse floor, taking ownership, and motivating people to achieve operational goals.

Who You Are?

• A natural team leader who leads by example and communicates clearly.

• Structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented.

• Comfortable working in a dynamic international logistics environment.

• Focused on quality, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

• Proactive and capable of making operational decisions independently.

must haves

• Minimum 3 years of experience within warehouse or logistics operations.

• Proven experience as a Warehouse Supervisor, Team Leader, or Warehouse Coordinator.

• Experience managing and motivating operational teams.

• Strong understanding of inbound, outbound, inventory management, and warehouse KPIs.

• Hands-on experience with a Warehouse Management System (WMS).

• Good knowledge of international logistics and imported goods flows.

• Professional proficiency in English and Spanish. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a strong asset
